# The High Route

> > A reader-supported backcountry dispatch covering ski mountaineering, avalanche safety, and mountain culture through in-depth gear reviews, technical guides, and field stories.

The High Route is an independent publication founded by Jason Albert, featuring contributions from ski mountaineers like Gavin Hess, Peter Vordenberg, and Billy Haas. It combines long-form storytelling with practical technical education for backcountry skiers and splitboarders, available through digital subscriptions and a printed journal.

- [Featured](https://the-high-route.com/featured): Curated collection of top gear reviews and opinion pieces
- [THR Resources](https://the-high-route.com/thr-resources): Comprehensive index of ski mountaineering guides and techniques

## Avalanche Safety & Education

- [Avalanche Department](https://the-high-route.com/avalanche-department): Avalanche safety, education, forecasting, and rescue techniques
- [Effective Response](https://the-high-route.com/effective-response): Joe Stock's avalanche first aid and resuscitation workflow guide
- [Avalanche Education: Learning the Basics and Brushing up](https://the-high-route.com/avalanche-education-learning-the-basics-and-brushing-up): Avalanche safety fundamentals and beacon practice for beginners
- [Transceiver Test: Signal Acquisition](https://the-high-route.com/transceiver-test-signal-acquisition): Testing avalanche transceiver signal acquisition with Barryvox S
- [Taking the Class: Avalanche Forecasting with Nikki Champion](https://the-high-route.com/taking-the-class-avalanche-forecasting-with-nikki-champion): Review of Nikki Champion's avalanche forecasting course by Utah forecaster

## Gear Reviews & Testing

- [Gear Shed](https://the-high-route.com/gear-shed): Backcountry ski and mountaineering gear reviews and testing
- [Considering Powerstraps](https://the-high-route.com/considering-powerstraps): Ski boot powerstrap design analysis featuring Tecnica Zero G Tour Pro
- [Skin Glue Reboot 2.0—The Whole Enchilada](https://the-high-route.com/skin-glue-reboot-2-0-the-whole-enchilada): DIY guide for removing and regluing climbing skins with G3 adhesive

## Technical Skills & Guides

- [Skill Building](https://the-high-route.com/backcountry-101/skill-building): Complete index of backcountry skiing skills and techniques articles
- [Master the Shoulder Axe Carry](https://the-high-route.com/master-the-shoulder-axe-carry): Ice axe carrying technique for steep skiing and splitboarding
- [The Skinny Rope Q & A: Rappelling with a Super Münter on Skinny Lines](https://the-high-route.com/the-skinny-rope-q-a-rapping-with-a-super-munter-on-skinny-lines): Super Münter hitch technique for rappelling on skinny ropes
- [Rappelling on Skinny Ropes Part 2—Tethers and Third Hands](https://the-high-route.com/rappelling-on-skinny-ropes-tethers-and-third-hands): Rappel extensions and friction hitch systems for ski mountaineering
